bio: Kiin Kiin means ‘come and eat’ in Thai – and you’d be foolish not to take up the invitation. You enter into a dimly lit basement, where you might start to wonder if there’s a restaurant here at all, but this moody lounge is all part of the experience – the spot to enjoy pre-meal snacks comprising refined versions of street food. After this, head up to the tasteful dining room decorated with golden Buddha wall hangings and choose from innovative Thai dishes with a playful edge. You might find tom yum soup prepared in a coffee machine, a savoury creme brûlée or pandan ice cream with burning rum....
